{
  "summary": "Adversarial topology adjudication of SPECIALIST_REVIEWS.json (R1-R3) against source code and supplemental audits confirms core descriptive findings while rejecting multiple overclaimed defects and invalid proposed fixes. Established facts: all 1,344 production and 336 central-force cases converged; alternating-hexagon flips (arms 1-2) strictly preserve degree sequences and directional edge counts but achieve small clustering contrasts (0.0037-0.0230 at z >= 3.2); fixed-node degree-squared swaps (arm 3) co-change degree variance, triangle density, collinear bending motifs (bends), and component fragmentation; and matched_final_stress is algebraically 0.1 * retention in this linear model. Rejected specialist overclaims: (1) winding-vector rank 2 is not graph biconnectivity, and neither directional winding booleans nor G0 > 1e-6 prove full 2D rigidity; (2) mean finite-cluster size including s=1 isolates (susceptibility) and whole-grid clustering with degree < 2 set to zero are valid declared conventions, not implementation bugs; (3) finite 100*N arm-3 chains across L in {12,18,24} and n=4 seeds do not establish thermodynamic lattice-gas phase separation, an exact k in {0,6} distribution, or absence of relative hubs, and rescaling stress by giant-component size cancels identically in retention and stress/G0; (4) replacing uniform hexagon proposals with indexed active-hexagon sampling without a Hastings proposal-count ratio violates detailed balance; and (5) reusing seed streams across z is a valid common-random-number (CRN) block design, not a bug requiring mandatory independent seeds. Agreement among R1-R3 is same-model consensus, not independent validation, and all results remain descriptive properties of a dimensionless linearized toy model rather than physical collagen, aging, or phase-transition evidence.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Winding rank is conflated with graph biconnectivity, and valid conditional cluster/clustering conventions are misclassified as bugs",
      "source_file": "SPECIALIST_REVIEWS.json",
      "source_line": 12,
      "evidence": "R1 (lines 7, 12) labels rank-2 cycle winding vectors '2D biconnected wrapping', while R1 (lines 17-22) and R3 (lines 185-190) classify susceptibility = sum(s^2)/sum(s) over non-giant components (source/cpu-sweep.py line 64) and whole-grid clustering with k < 2 set to 0 (line 63) as metric artifacts.",
      "implication": "While a single (-1,1) cycle indeed sets both wrap_basis_1 and wrap_basis_2 to True (source/cpu-sweep.py line 60), torus homology rank 2 does not imply graph biconnectivity (absence of cut vertices) or mechanical rigidity. Likewise, mean finite-cluster size including isolates (which equals 1.0 when only isolates remain) and whole-grid local clustering are valid, explicitly declared conventions (ACTUAL_DESIGN.md line 17; analysis/SUPPLEMENTAL_AUDIT.json lines 133-134). Volume-normalized second moments, isolate fractions, and k >= 2 conditional clustering are complementary metrics that require graph reconstruction from seeds/masks (analysis/SUPPLEMENTAL_AUDIT.json line 135), not bug fixes.",
      "recommended_check": "Retain existing susceptibility and clustering definitions as declared observables; if reconstructing graphs from seeds and mask_sha256, add per-component winding-matrix rank (labeled torus homology rank, never biconnectivity), isolated-node fraction, and k >= 2 clustering as supplementary columns.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Overclaimed thermodynamic k=0/k=6 condensation, unsupported z_eff = z/S_largest heuristic, and invalid area-cancellation algebra in arm 3",
      "source_file": "SPECIALIST_REVIEWS.json",
      "source_line": 169,
      "evidence": "R1 (lines 37-42) and R3 (lines 145-150) claim 100*N arm-3 swaps drive non-convergent finite-size condensation into k=6 crystalline patches and k=0 vacancies without hubs, and R3 (lines 165-170) claims giant-component depletion raises subgraph coordination to z_eff ~ z / largest_component_mean and that normalizing stress by active nodes N_LC instead of N (source/cpu-sweep.py line 93) explains retention_delta_mean.",
      "implication": "Arm 3 is an explicitly finite 100*N fixed-node intervention at k <= 6, not a stationary equilibrium ensemble (ACTUAL_DESIGN.md line 7; SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md lines 13, 24); 3 sizes and 4 seeds do not establish thermodynamic phase separation or an exact bimodal k in {0,6} distribution, and relative hubs exist (degree_variance_mean = 4.32-7.45). Moreover, z / S_largest equals giant-component mean degree only if no edges reside outside the giant component (false whenever finite clusters have s >= 2, as in analysis/graph-summary.csv line 73 where susceptibility_mean = 10.01). Crucially, any fixed active-area factor N_LC cancels identically in retention = s(t)/s(0) and matched_final_stress = s(t)/G0 (SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 26), so area renormalization cannot algebraically explain any retention shift.",
      "recommended_check": "Reject active-area renormalization as an explanation for retention_delta_mean; reconstruct exact giant-component internal edge counts and node degree distributions P(k) from deterministic seeds if subgraph coordination is of interest.",
      "claim_status": "hypothesis"
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Unadjusted rejection-free hexagon sampling violates detailed balance, and dividing contrasts by tiny triangle shifts is unstable",
      "source_file": "SPECIALIST_REVIEWS.json",
      "source_line": 81,
      "evidence": "To overcome low acceptance (~0.2% at L=24, z=4.8 in analysis/graph-summary.csv lines 83-84) and small clustering shifts (0.0037-0.0230), R2 (lines 81, 126) recommends rejection-free sampling from indexed active alternating hexagons with a Metropolis penalty, while R3 (line 180) recommends dividing mechanical contrasts by unit triangle or transitivity change.",
      "implication": "Low achieved triangle contrast in arms 1-2 genuinely prevents concluding that clustering is mechanically unimportant, and unconstrained collinear bending motifs (bends, source/cpu-sweep.py line 80; now aggregated in analysis/graph-supplement.csv lines 2-85) confound kappa > 0 contrasts. However, because flipping an alternating hexagon changes the number of active alternating hexagons N_hex(G) -> N_hex(G'), uniform sampling from an indexed active list has asymmetric forward/reverse proposal probabilities; retaining the naive Metropolis acceptance formula without the Hastings ratio N_hex(G)/N_hex(G') (or BKL time weighting) alters the target sampling measure (SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 11). Furthermore, dividing mechanical deltas by near-zero Δclustering or ΔT when bends co-vary yields unstable, non-causal ratio estimates (SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 28).",
      "recommended_check": "Report mechanical effect sizes alongside paired Δtriangles and Δbends without ratio division; if implementing indexed hexagon proposals or joint (ΔT, Δbends) energies, include the exact Hastings proposal-count ratio N_hex(G)/N_hex(G') and declare the modified target measure.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Operational G0 > 1e-6 eligibility gate is stable across 1e-8..1e-4, distinct from physical rigidity, and redundant with matched_final_stress",
      "source_file": "analysis/SUPPLEMENTAL_AUDIT.json",
      "source_line": 47,
      "evidence": "Across G0 thresholds of 1e-8, 1e-6, and 1e-4 (lines 4, 47, 88), eligible production cases are 584, 584, and 582, with identical L=24, z=4.8 contrast means, while matched_metric_redundancy_max_error is 2.82e-8 (line 130) and unconditioned G0_mean is provided in analysis/graph-supplement.csv (lines 2-85).",
      "implication": "The specialists correctly note that complete-case conditioning drops all z <= 2.4 pairs and induces partial pair attrition in arm 3 at z = 3.2 (L=12: 3/4, L=18: 2/4 in analysis/paired-summary.csv lines 28, 70), and that matched_final_stress = 0.1 * retention is algebraically redundant (source/cpu-sweep.py lines 95, 100). However, G0 > 1e-6 is a declared operational gate to prevent division by zero in stress/G0 (ACTUAL_DESIGN.md line 13), not a universal rigidity threshold or proof of full strain-mode rigidity (SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md lines 5, 19). Unconditioned stiffness (analysis/graph-supplement.csv) and conditional matched-stiffness relaxation address separate scientific questions, and high-density contrasts are insensitive to the operational cutoff.",
      "recommended_check": "Present unconditioned G0_mean (from analysis/graph-supplement.csv) when discussing stiffness onset at z <= 3.2, keep conditional retention for G0-matched relaxation at z >= 3.2, and drop matched_final_stress from independent-observable claims.",
      "claim_status": "simulation_result"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Common-random-number seed sharing across z is a valid block design, not a bug, though model scope and sample size remain strictly limited",
      "source_file": "source/cpu-sweep.py",
      "source_line": 108,
      "evidence": "Graph generation uses seed (74000 if L==24 else 73000)+seed across all seven z targets (line 108), yielding 12 size-seed blocks and 311 unique masks across 336 variants (analysis/SUMMARY.json lines 5-9), which R1 (line 52) and R2 (line 121) critique as a defect requiring independent seeds per (L, z).",
      "implication": "Sharing initial PRNG streams across z is a valid common-random-number (CRN) variance-reduction block design, not a replication defect, provided uncertainty is interpreted within the 12 size-seed blocks rather than treating z levels, time steps, or (kappa, r) repeats as independent specimens (ACTUAL_DESIGN.md line 9; SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 15). Conversely, n=4 seeds per size, Δz=0.4 spacing, 16-case L=12 dt refinement, and linearized small-strain kinematics genuinely preclude finite-size phase-boundary estimation, nonlinear strain-stiffening claims, or biological collagen inference. Consensus across R1-R3 in SPECIALIST_REVIEWS.json reflects shared-model review, not independent validation.",
      "recommended_check": "Retain CRN blocking for paired treatment contrasts while explicitly stating n=4 block limits, or use independent per-(L,z) seeds only if conducting a dedicated unblocked finite-size percolation study.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    }
  ],
  "strongest_surviving_claim": "Within the declared dimensionless small-strain linearized triangular-network model with assumed exponential axial strain-memory relaxation (r = 0.5, hold strain 0.1, duration 5), all 1,344 production and 336 central-force solves converged, passing directional gradient, translational-null, and elastic-retention checks. In the well-connected regime (z in {4.0, 4.8}, where all 4 seed pairs per size pass the G0 > 1e-6 operational gate across 1e-8..1e-4 sensitivity checks), the finite 100*N degree-squared edge-replacement intervention (arm 3)—which jointly increases degree variance, triangle clustering, and active bending motifs while reducing largest-component fraction by 13%-24%—reproducibly lowers stress retention relative to uniform dilution (arm 0) at kappa in {0.003, 0.03}, whereas degree-preserving alternating-hexagon flips (arms 1 vs 2) achieve only 0.4%-2.3% clustering shifts with near-zero retention differences and co-varying bending motif counts.",
  "decisive_next_experiment": "Ranked next studies preserving physical-model scope and sampling-measure validity: (1) Zero-new-simulation deterministic reconstruction (Rank 1): Using existing code, seeds (73000-73003, 74000-74003), and mask_sha256 hashes, reconstruct the 336 graphs to tabulate exact node degree distributions P(k), isolated-node fractions, giant-component internal edge and bending-motif counts, k >= 2 conditional clustering, and per-component torus winding-matrix rank (distinguishing rank 1 vs rank 2 homology without conflating with biconnectivity), and fit within-seed regressions of retention on Δbends, Δtriangles, and Δdegree_variance. (2) Measure-preserving indexed hexagon-flip sweep (Rank 2): At L=24, z in {3.2, 4.0, 4.8}, implement rejection-free proposals over indexed active alternating hexagons with the exact Hastings proposal-count correction N_hex(G)/N_hex(G') (and an explicit joint energy term on Δbends if holding bending motifs fixed) to test whether larger degree-preserving clustering contrasts (Δclustering >= 0.05) are combinatorially reachable and mechanically consequential. (3) Constrained hub/fragmentation separation sweep (Rank 3): Run fixed-node edge swaps at L=24, z in {3.2, 4.0, 4.8} under a declared constrained target measure that rejects moves creating degree-0 isolates or disconnecting the wrapping component, with a tunable triangle penalty, to separate degree heterogeneity from network fragmentation and triangle clumping.",
